## Decision Context

What architecture decision is needed?

## Drivers and Constraints

List decision drivers, constraints, and risk factors.

## Related RFC

Reference required RFC (for material changes).

## Proposed Decision

Describe the proposed ADR outcome.

## Consequences

Expected positive/negative consequences and residual risks.

## Documentation Synchronization Plan

List affected docs, diagrams, examples, controls, and release notes.

## Review Checklist

- [ ] Threat model impact considered
- [ ] Control mapping impact considered
- [ ] Diagram updates identified
- [ ] Public-release suitability confirmed
